LanguageData.pas_settlement_LordChanceTip: Chance per scan (every ~1 in-game hour) that an ungoverned NPC settlement is appointed a named lord. Controls how fast lords take office; 0 disables new appointments (existing lords keep working).
LanguageData.pas_settlement_GovAmplitudeTip: How strongly lord attributes swing settlement point growth: attributes at 100 give a x(1+X) governance factor, at 0 give x(1-X). Applied per settlement on each Rim War growth cycle; faction-level growth stats are never modified. 0 disables the growth effect entirely.
LanguageData.pas_settlement_DecayEnabledTip: When enabled, a lord with a governance factor below 1 drains the settlement's Rim War points each growth cycle (net decay, stopping at the Rim War floor of 100). When disabled, poor lords merely fail to add growth.
